cause_quote: The diff removed `if (acceptedKey && mode !== "session") { this.onPaneSessionChange?.(this.paneId, acceptedKey); }`, so a successful retry of a background launch left the source pane and its error banner visible.
user_saw: The Control UI kept showing the launch error after the suggested task started successfully on retry.
summary: A confirmed suggested-task retry now clears its own stale error from both shared chat fields while preserving newer and unrelated errors.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #151611 and verified that a successful retry in the default local mode switched the visible pane to the newly created session. The background-launch change removed that switch while retaining both error assignments, leaving the old banner visible after success. The earlier in-session mode already stayed in place, but the fix's retry tests exercise the default local launch path.
